scope: Node VM of actual prototype lifecycle callbacks, deterministic timers, minimal DOM. No real web contents, CSS, ACP, Electron, credentials or paid calls tested.

tests.name: Opening an empty viewer does not create an owner or a tab
Repeated reveals preserve the existing active tab and never duplicate it
URL deduplication is within the owner; different sessions own different tabs
Renaming a session preserves owner identity and browsing state
A changed task with the same session label has a separate owner
Opening persisted owners after session UUID refresh creates no new workspace
Project switch does not stop a background run or reveal into another project
Two concurrent sessions finish independently
Pause invalidates an already captured timer callback
Resume completes once and saves the captured URL
Stop keeps tabs but stale callbacks cannot create a result
Resume rejects a changed target URL instead of continuing the wrong page
Resume rejects a closed target tab
Reload makes persisted running fixtures paused, never falsely live
Agent work never invokes transfer to the user browser implicitly
Explicit Open at mine transfers only the selected URL
Reveal deferred by layout retains a clickable pending result
Presenting another owner while user interacts with current owner cannot replace it
Stale mapping cannot expose an owner from another project
Project rename preserves the running owner and its target tab
Modal callbacks reject a changed session even if stale DOM remains callable
Viewing another tab does not show the running cursor on that tab
Observer tab selection leaves execution active tab unchanged and removes its cursor
Typing in the personal browser defers an automatic presentation
An open modal defers presentation without replacing its content
Turning off automatic reveal still leaves a result invitation
Auto-presentation cannot rerender a focused browser field
Background redraw skipped during input catches up when focus leaves
Preparing a follow-up request does not retarget the current running browser
A stale stop control cannot overwrite a completed result
